meta.parties: Raman Chetty Et Al v. Mohideen

rules.statement: In an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code against a successful claimant, the judgment-creditor cannot prove the title by prescription of the judgment-debtor unless the judgment-debtor is a party to the suit.
rules.supporting_quote: "On these grounds I would allow the appeal, and direct decree to be entered up dismissing the respondents' action, with the costs of the potion and of the appeal."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code
